title: Topic
description: A Kafka-API topic on the event bus plus the JSON Schema every message on it must satisfy (plan.md §6).

name.description: <domain>.<event>.v<N>, e.g. email.triaged.v1. A breaking change creates a new version.

schema.description: JSON Schema for the payload. Objects must set additionalProperties: false. Strings must be typed (enum, pattern, format) or marked x-free-text: true with a maxLength.

retention.description: How long messages are kept. This is also the replay window. e.g. 72h or 7d.

partitions.description: 1 keeps total ordering. More partitions give throughput; set a key for per-entity ordering.

key.description: Payload field used as the partition key. Must be a property of the schema.
